neighbours.label: the word 'industrial' (and the industri-/промышлен- stem)
fire: The old warehouse was converted into an industrial loft with brick walls.

The town grew quickly during the industrial revolution.
They chose an industrial style kitchen with steel shelves.
Many industrial workers lost their jobs when the mill closed.
The region exports industrial machinery to neighboring countries.
Noise from the industrial park kept the residents awake.
quiet: The old warehouse was converted into a cozy loft with brick walls.

notes: Card: ' industrial' x15, ' Industrial' x5, Russian промыш|лен. Near misses swap in related words (factory, manufacturing contexts) to separate the word from the topic. Opposite pole weak (max 3.8): ' social', ' civil' as sector adjectives.
